question: For what purpose is salutation offered to the foot-water in this rite?
premises: Salutation is directed to the foot-water.
The stated purpose is the pacifying of sin.
The salutation is offered to you.
inference: Salutation is offered to the foot-water for the purpose of pacifying sin.
plain_english: Salutation to you, to the foot-water, for the purpose of pacifying sin.
